zoe (design): Quick sketch: hide the page-level schema banner. instead, add a tiny validation pin per fn row that shows a count and expands an inline panel with errors. Cleaner editor.
omar (devex): Agree. Does the pin open an overlay or inline accordion? inline is less disruptive.
zoe (design): Inline accordion. shows short message lines + a link that jumps to the offending input field.
lia (backend): backend ok with that. when user opens the accordion we'll re-run the linter for freshness. suggest debounce 250ms and cache last successful result for 30s to avoid thrash.
paul (a11y): Accessibility: the inline panel must use role="region" and aria-label="function validation". New errors should be announced via aria-live="polite". Keyboard: Enter toggles, Arrow keys navigate errors, Esc closes.
omar (devex): Nice. I'll implement keyboard handling: Enter toggles, Shift+Enter focuses first error link, Esc closes and returns focus to the pin. Also add visible focus ring styles.
zoe (design): Another piece: compact run-history card in the playground. shows tool name, a one-line summary (first sentence), and a tiny cost chip with tokens/USD. expand shows full structured output (tabs: Request / Response / Meta) and supports streaming.
mike (product): Cost chip is helpful. PMs want approximate tokens + USD. can it be optional if cost unknown?
lia (backend): Yes. Data contract: summaryText (<=256 chars), pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, timestamp. Store pointer only; lazy-load full payload on expand. streaming runs set isStreaming=true so UI shows live indicator.
omar (devex): UI nit: compact summary should truncate at sentence boundary if possible. streaming state shows a pulsing dot and "live" label. expand moves focus into the output area and traps focus until closed.
paul (a11y): Focus trap ok if there's a clear close control; on expansion announce "Tool output expanded". Ensure the cost chip is accessible (aria-label="Estimated cost: 12 tokens, $0.01").
zoe (design): Copy tweak: use "Call arguments" instead of "Args" and "Tool result" instead of "Result"—less ambiguous.
mike (product): Rollout: beta to 10% of org, measure expand rate and avg cost per run. if avg cost delta > 10% revert. Also track number of lazy-loads to see backend load.
lia (backend): I'll draft an RFC for the pointer + caching behavior and include limits (summary max length, retention for pointers). will add debounce on the linter endpoint.
deploy-bot: zoe uploaded preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-pin-compact-card
omar (devex): Action items: lia RFC + pointer, lia debounce + cache, paul accessibility checklist, zoe final frames and copy, mike experiment config. I'll own the keyboard/focus RFC.
zoe (design): Thanks all! I'll attach final frames in the doc this afternoon. :sparkles:
